ko.title: [농업 입문 101 #12] 해충, 잡초, 그리고 반격하는 작은 동맹

segments.src: > Managing pests and weeds isn't about wiping them out—it's about keeping them below the level where they cost you more than the crop is worth.
segments.tr: > 해충과 잡초 관리는 완전히 제거하는 것이 아니라—그들이 입히는 피해가 작물의 가치보다 더 많이 드는 수준 이하로 유지하는 것입니다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Every field is a crowded neighborhood.
segments.tr: 모든 밭은 북적이는 동네입니다.

segments.src: Your crop lives there, but so do insects that chew on it, and weeds that race it for sunlight, water, and nutrients.
segments.tr: 당신의 작물이 그곳에 살고, 그것을 먹는 곤충들도, 햇빛, 물, 영양분을 놓고 경쟁하는 잡초들도 살고 있습니다.

segments.src: The goal of pest and weed management is not zero bugs and zero weeds—that's usually impossible and rarely worth the cost.
segments.tr: 해충과 잡초 관리의 목표는 해충 제로, 잡초 제로가 아닙니다—그것은 보통 불가능하고 비용을 들일 가치가 거의 없습니다.

segments.src: The goal is to keep them below the "economic threshold," the point where the damage they cause is finally worth spending money to stop.
segments.tr: 목표는 그들을 "경제적 임계값" 이하로 유지하는 것입니다—그들이 입히는 피해를 막는 데 돈을 쓸 만큼 충분히 심각해지는 지점입니다.

segments.src: Three ideas do most of the work:
segments.tr: 세 가지 개념이 대부분의 일을 합니다:

segments.src: **Pest ecology.** A pest is just an organism whose population happens to boom where we don't want it.
segments.tr: **해충 생태학.** 해충은 단순히 우리가 원하지 않는 곳에서 개체군이 급증하는 생물일 뿐입니다.

segments.src: Understanding its life cycle—when it lays eggs, what weather it likes, what it eats—tells you the cheapest moment to intervene.
segments.tr: 그 생활 주기를 이해하는 것—언제 알을 낳는지, 어떤 날씨를 좋아하는지, 무엇을 먹는지—개입하기에 가장 저렴한 시기를 알려줍니다.

segments.src: Hit a corn borer as a young larva and a little effort goes a long way; wait until it's tunneled deep into the stalk and you've lost your window.
segments.tr: 옥수수 천공충을 어린 유충 단계에서 공격하면 적은 노력으로도 큰 효과를 얻을 수 있습니다; 그것이 줄기 깊숙이 굴파할 때까지 기다리면 적절한 시기를 놓칩니다.

segments.src: **Natural enemies (biological control).** Most pests already have predators and parasites.
segments.tr: **천적 (생물학적 방제).** 대부분의 해충은 이미 천연의 포식자와 기생충을 가지고 있습니다.

segments.src: Ladybugs and lacewings eat aphids by the hundreds.
segments.tr: 무당벌레와 풀잠자리는 진딧물을 수백 마리씩 먹습니다.

segments.src: Tiny parasitic wasps lay eggs inside caterpillars.
segments.tr: 작은 기생 말벌은 애벌레의 몸 안에 알을 낳습니다.

segments.src: Encouraging these "natural enemies"—by planting flower strips, avoiding sprays that kill them, or even releasing them on purpose—turns the ecosystem into free labor.
segments.tr: 이러한 "천적"을 장려하면서—꽃 스트립을 심고, 그들을 죽이는 분무를 피하거나, 의도적으로 방출함으로써—생태계 자체가 해충 방제를 해주도록 만듭니다.

segments.src: **Weed control.** Weeds don't bite, but they steal.
segments.tr: **잡초 관리.** 잡초는 물지는 않지만 훔칩니다.

segments.src: They compete for the same resources and can slash yields quietly.
segments.tr: 같은 자원을 놓고 경쟁하면서 조용히 수확량을 깎아내릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Control combines mechanical methods (tilling, mowing, mulching), cultural methods (crop rotation, cover crops that shade weeds out), and herbicides used carefully.
segments.tr: 관리는 기계적 방법(경운, 풀 깎기, 멀칭), 문화적 방법(작물 순환, 잡초를 그늘로 억제하는 덮개 작물), 그리고 신중하게 사용되는 제초제를 결합합니다.

segments.src: The modern umbrella term for combining all of this is **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)**: scout the field, identify the actual threat, use the least disruptive tool first, and reach for chemicals only when the numbers justify it.
segments.tr: 이 모든 것을 결합하는 현대적 포괄 용어는 **통합 해충 관리(IPM)**입니다: 밭을 정찰하고, 실제 위협을 파악하고, 가장 방해가 적은 도구를 먼저 사용하고, 숫자가 정당화될 때만 화학약품을 사용합니다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 일상에서

segments.src: Picture a family growing tomatoes in a backyard garden in central Ohio.
segments.tr: 오하이오 중부의 뒷마당 정원에서 토마토를 키우는 가족을 상상해보세요.

segments.src: In June, aphids show up on the new leaves.
segments.tr: 6월에 새로운 잎에 진딧물이 나타납니다.

segments.src: The instinct is to grab a bottle of broad-spectrum insecticide from the hardware store for $12 and soak everything.
segments.tr: 본능적으로 철물점에서 12달러짜리 광범위 살충제를 집어 들고 모든 것을 적시려고 합니다.

segments.src: An IPM-minded gardener pauses.
segments.tr: IPM 사고방식을 가진 정원사는 멈춥니다.

segments.src: They flip a leaf over and notice ladybug larvae—little spiky orange-and-black creatures—already eating the aphids.
segments.tr: 잎을 뒤집어 보니 무당벌레 유충—작고 가시 같은 주황색과 검은색의 생물—이 이미 진딧물을 먹고 있습니다.

segments.src: Spraying now would kill those helpers too, and the aphids would just bounce back next week with nobody left to eat them.
segments.tr: 지금 분무하면 그 도우미들도 죽고, 진딧물은 다음 주에 그들을 먹을 것이 아무도 남지 않은 상태로 다시 나타날 것입니다.

segments.src: Instead, the gardener sprays a strong jet of water to knock down the worst clusters and plants a few marigolds and sweet alyssum nearby to attract more beneficial insects.
segments.tr: 대신 정원사는 강한 물 분사로 최악의 군집을 떨어내고, 근처에 몇 금잔화와 스윗 앨리섬을 심어 더 많은 유익한 곤충을 유인합니다.

segments.src: Meanwhile, crabgrass is creeping into the bed.
segments.tr: 한편, 바랭이가 화단으로 퍼져나가고 있습니다.

segments.src: Rather than dumping herbicide next to food they'll eat, they lay down a couple inches of straw mulch.
segments.tr: 먹을 음식 옆에 제초제를 사용하기보다는, 몇 인치의 짚 멀칭을 깔아 놓습니다.

segments.src: The mulch blocks sunlight so new weed seeds can't sprout, holds moisture, and costs about $6 a bale.
segments.tr: 멀칭은 햇빛을 차단하여 새로운 잡초 씨앗이 발아할 수 없게 하고, 수분을 유지하며, 깔따기당 약 6달러가 듭니다.

segments.src: By July, the aphids are under control by the ladybugs, the crabgrass is smothered, and the tomatoes never touched a pesticide.
segments.tr: 7월까지 진딧물은 무당벌레에 의해 통제되고, 바랭이는 억제되며, 토마토는 농약을 한 번도 맞지 않습니다.

segments.src: That's the same logic a commercial farm in the Central Valley uses—just scaled up with field scouts and thresholds instead of a hunch.
segments.tr: 그것은 중앙 계곡의 상업 농장이 사용하는 같은 논리입니다—단지 직감 대신 들판 정찰과 임계값을 사용해서 규모를 늘린 것입니다.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 세 줄 요약

segments.src: 1. The aim is to keep pests and weeds below an economic threshold, not to eliminate them entirely.
segments.tr: 1. 목표는 해충과 잡초를 경제적 임계값 이하로 유지하는 것이지, 완전히 제거하는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: 2. Natural enemies like ladybugs and parasitic wasps provide free, self-renewing pest control—so avoid killing them with careless spraying.
segments.tr: 2. 무당벌레와 기생 말벌 같은 천적은 무료이고 자동으로 갱신되는 해충 방제를 제공합니다—따라서 부주의한 분무로 그들을 죽이는 것을 피하세요.

segments.src: 3. Integrated Pest Management (IPM) layers scouting, biological, mechanical, and cultural methods, using chemicals only as a last resort.
segments.tr: 3. 통합 해충 관리(IPM)는 정찰, 생물학적, 기계적, 문화적 방법을 함께 사용하며, 화학약품은 최후의 수단으로만 사용합니다.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 자가 평가

segments.src: 1. The "economic threshold" refers to:
segments.tr: 1. "경제적 임계값"은 다음을 의미합니다:

segments.src: - A) The price of a bag of seed
segments.tr: - A) 한 자루 종자의 가격

segments.src: - B) The pest population level at which control costs less than the damage prevented
segments.tr: - B) 방제 비용이 예방된 피해보다 적은 해충 개체군 수준

segments.src: - C) The number of weeds allowed by law
segments.tr: - C) 법에 의해 허용되는 잡초의 수

segments.src: 2. O/X: Spraying a broad-spectrum insecticide at the first sign of aphids is usually the smartest first move.
segments.tr: 2. O/X: 진딧물이 처음 나타났을 때 광범위 살충제를 분무하는 것이 보통 가장 똑똑한 첫 번째 조치입니다.

segments.src: 3. Which of these is a *biological* control method?
segments.tr: 3. 이 중 어느 것이 *생물학적* 방제 방법입니까?

segments.src: - A) Tilling the soil to bury weeds
segments.tr: - A) 잡초를 묻기 위해 토양을 경운하기

segments.src: - B) Applying a herbicide
segments.tr: - B) 제초제 적용

segments.src: - C) Releasing parasitic wasps to attack caterpillars
segments.tr: - C) 애벌레를 공격하기 위해 기생 말벌을 방출하기

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Economic threshold** — The pest density at which the cost of control equals the crop loss it prevents; the tipping point for taking action.
segments.tr: - **경제적 임계값** — 방제 비용이 그것이 예방하는 작물 손실과 같아지는 해충 밀도; 조치를 취하는 전환점입니다.

segments.src: - **Natural enemy** — A predator, parasite, or pathogen that suppresses a pest population naturally.
segments.tr: - **천적** — 해충 개체군을 자연적으로 억제하는 포식자, 기생생물, 또는 병원체입니다.

segments.src: - **Biological control** — Using living organisms (like ladybugs or parasitic wasps) to keep pests in check.
segments.tr: - **생물학적 방제** — 해충을 제어하기 위해 살아있는 생물체(무당벌레나 기생 말벌 같은)를 사용하는 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)** — A strategy that combines monitoring with biological, cultural, mechanical, and chemical tools, minimizing reliance on any single method.
segments.tr: - **통합 해충 관리(IPM)** — 모니터링을 생물학적, 문화적, 기계적, 화학적 도구와 결합하는 전략이며, 어떤 단일 방법에 대한 의존성을 최소화합니다.

segments.src: - **Cover crop** — A plant grown mainly to protect and improve soil, which can also shade out and suppress weeds.
segments.tr: - **덮개 작물** — 주로 토양을 보호하고 개선하기 위해 재배되는 식물이며, 잡초를 그늘로 억제할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: *Answers: 1) B — the threshold is about economics, spending on control only when damage would cost more.
segments.tr: *답변: 1) B — 임계값은 경제학에 관한 것이며, 피해가 더 많은 비용이 들 때만 방제에 지출합니다.

segments.src: 2) X — broad-spectrum sprays often kill the beneficial insects too, so pests rebound; scout first and use the least disruptive tool.
segments.tr: 2) X — 광범위 분무는 종종 유익한 곤충도 죽이므로, 해충이 다시 나타납니다; 먼저 정찰하고 가장 방해가 적은 도구를 사용하세요.

segments.src: 3) C — releasing parasitic wasps uses a living organism, making it biological control; tilling is mechanical and herbicide is chemical.*
segments.tr: 3) C — 기생 말벌을 방출하는 것은 살아있는 생물체를 사용하므로 생물학적 방제입니다; 경운은 기계적이고 제초제는 화학적입니다.*

zh.title: [农业101 #12] 虫害、杂草和对抗它们的微小盟友

segments.src: > Managing pests and weeds isn't about wiping them out—it's about keeping them below the level where they cost you more than the crop is worth.
segments.tr: > 管理害虫和杂草不是要彻底消灭它们——而是将其保持在低于造成的成本超过农作物价值的水平。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今天的概念

segments.src: Every field is a crowded neighborhood.
segments.tr: 每块田地都是一个拥挤的社区。

segments.src: Your crop lives there, but so do insects that chew on it, and weeds that race it for sunlight, water, and nutrients.
segments.tr: 你的庄稼生长在那里，但那里也有咀嚼它的昆虫，以及与它争夺阳光、水分和养分的杂草。

segments.src: The goal of pest and weed management is not zero bugs and zero weeds—that's usually impossible and rarely worth the cost.
segments.tr: 害虫和杂草管理的目标不是零虫害和零杂草——这通常是不可能的，而且很少值得付出代价。

segments.src: The goal is to keep them below the "economic threshold," the point where the damage they cause is finally worth spending money to stop.
segments.tr: 目标是将其保持在"经济阈值"以下，即防治造成的损害最终值得花钱解决的水平。

segments.src: Three ideas do most of the work:
segments.tr: 三个观点做了大部分工作：

segments.src: **Pest ecology.** A pest is just an organism whose population happens to boom where we don't want it.
segments.tr: **害虫生态学。** 害虫只是一种生物体，其种群恰好在我们不希望的地方大量繁殖。

segments.src: Understanding its life cycle—when it lays eggs, what weather it likes, what it eats—tells you the cheapest moment to intervene.
segments.tr: 了解其生活周期——何时产卵、喜欢什么天气、吃什么——会告诉你最便宜的干预时刻。

segments.src: Hit a corn borer as a young larva and a little effort goes a long way; wait until it's tunneled deep into the stalk and you've lost your window.
segments.tr: 在玉米螟是幼虫时击中它，少量努力就能走很远；等到它深深地钻入茎秆，你就失去了机会。

segments.src: **Natural enemies (biological control).** Most pests already have predators and parasites.
segments.tr: **天敌（生物防治）。** 大多数害虫已经有掠食者和寄生虫。

segments.src: Ladybugs and lacewings eat aphids by the hundreds.
segments.tr: 瓢虫和草蛉成百地吃蚜虫。

segments.src: Tiny parasitic wasps lay eggs inside caterpillars.
segments.tr: 微小的寄生蜂在毛毛虫内产卵。

segments.src: Encouraging these "natural enemies"—by planting flower strips, avoiding sprays that kill them, or even releasing them on purpose—turns the ecosystem into free labor.
segments.tr: 鼓励这些"天敌"——通过种植花带、避免使用杀死它们的喷剂，甚至故意释放它们——将生态系统变成免费劳动力。

segments.src: **Weed control.** Weeds don't bite, but they steal.
segments.tr: **杂草防控。** 杂草不会咬，但它们会偷窃。

segments.src: They compete for the same resources and can slash yields quietly.
segments.tr: 它们竞争相同的资源，可以悄悄地大幅削减产量。

segments.src: Control combines mechanical methods (tilling, mowing, mulching), cultural methods (crop rotation, cover crops that shade weeds out), and herbicides used carefully.
segments.tr: 防控结合了机械方法（耕作、割草、覆盖），农艺方法（轮作、遮挡杂草的覆盖作物）和谨慎使用的除草剂。

segments.src: The modern umbrella term for combining all of this is **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)**: scout the field, identify the actual threat, use the least disruptive tool first, and reach for chemicals only when the numbers justify it.
segments.tr: 将所有这些结合在一起的现代总称是**综合害虫管理（IPM）**：查察田地，确认实际威胁，首先使用干扰最少的工具，仅当数字证明时才使用化学物质。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活中

segments.src: Picture a family growing tomatoes in a backyard garden in central Ohio.
segments.tr: 想象一个家庭在俄亥俄州中部的后院花园里种植番茄。

segments.src: In June, aphids show up on the new leaves.
segments.tr: 在六月，蚜虫出现在新叶上。

segments.src: The instinct is to grab a bottle of broad-spectrum insecticide from the hardware store for $12 and soak everything.
segments.tr: 本能是从五金店抓起一瓶12美元的广谱杀虫剂，将一切浸透。

segments.src: An IPM-minded gardener pauses.
segments.tr: 一位有IPM思维的园丁停顿了。

segments.src: They flip a leaf over and notice ladybug larvae—little spiky orange-and-black creatures—already eating the aphids.
segments.tr: 他们翻转叶子，注意到瓢虫幼虫——小的带刺的橙黑色生物——已经在吃蚜虫。

segments.src: Spraying now would kill those helpers too, and the aphids would just bounce back next week with nobody left to eat them.
segments.tr: 现在喷洒会杀死那些帮手，蚜虫下周就会反弹，没有人吃它们。

segments.src: Instead, the gardener sprays a strong jet of water to knock down the worst clusters and plants a few marigolds and sweet alyssum nearby to attract more beneficial insects.
segments.tr: 相反，园丁喷射强力水流击退最严重的群集，并在附近种植几株万寿菊和香豌豆以吸引更多有益昆虫。

segments.src: Meanwhile, crabgrass is creeping into the bed.
segments.tr: 与此同时，马唐草悄悄进入花坛。

segments.src: Rather than dumping herbicide next to food they'll eat, they lay down a couple inches of straw mulch.
segments.tr: 他们没有在食物旁倒除草剂，而是铺上几英寸的秸秆覆盖物。

segments.src: The mulch blocks sunlight so new weed seeds can't sprout, holds moisture, and costs about $6 a bale.
segments.tr: 覆盖物阻挡阳光，使新杂草种子无法发芽，保持水分，每包成本约6美元。

segments.src: By July, the aphids are under control by the ladybugs, the crabgrass is smothered, and the tomatoes never touched a pesticide.
segments.tr: 到七月，蚜虫由瓢虫控制，马唐草被窒息，番茄从未接触过农药。

segments.src: That's the same logic a commercial farm in the Central Valley uses—just scaled up with field scouts and thresholds instead of a hunch.
segments.tr: 这与中央谷地商业农场使用的逻辑相同——只是用田间侦察和阈值进行了扩大，而不是凭直觉。

segments.src: 3. Integrated Pest Management (IPM) layers scouting, biological, mechanical, and cultural methods, using chemicals only as a last resort.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今天的术语

segments.src: - **Economic threshold** — The pest density at which the cost of control equals the crop loss it prevents; the tipping point for taking action.
segments.tr: - **经济阈值** — 防控成本等于防止的农作物损失的害虫密度；采取行动的临界点。

segments.src: - **Natural enemy** — A predator, parasite, or pathogen that suppresses a pest population naturally.
segments.tr: - **天敌** — 自然抑制害虫种群的捕食者、寄生虫或病原体。

segments.src: - **Biological control** — Using living organisms (like ladybugs or parasitic wasps) to keep pests in check.
segments.tr: - **生物防治** — 使用活生物体（如瓢虫或寄生蜂）来控制害虫。

segments.src: - **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)** — A strategy that combines monitoring with biological, cultural, mechanical, and chemical tools, minimizing reliance on any single method.

segments.src: - **Cover crop** — A plant grown mainly to protect and improve soil, which can also shade out and suppress weeds.

hi.title: [कृषि 101 #12] कीड़े, खरपतवार, और छोटे सहयोगी जो पलटवार करते हैं

segments.src: > Managing pests and weeds isn't about wiping them out—it's about keeping them below the level where they cost you more than the crop is worth.
segments.tr: > कीटों और खरपतवारों का प्रबंधन उन्हें पूरी तरह खत्म करने के बारे में नहीं है—यह उन्हें उस स्तर से नीचे रखने के बारे में है जहां वे आपको फसल के मूल्य से अधिक खर्च करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## आज की अवधारणा

segments.src: Every field is a crowded neighborhood.
segments.tr: हर खेत एक भीड़ भरा पड़ोस है।

segments.src: Your crop lives there, but so do insects that chew on it, and weeds that race it for sunlight, water, and nutrients.
segments.tr: आपकी फसल वहां रहती है, लेकिन कीड़े भी हैं जो इसे खाते हैं, और खरपतवार जो धूप, पानी और पोषक तत्वों के लिए इसके साथ प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं।

segments.src: The goal of pest and weed management is not zero bugs and zero weeds—that's usually impossible and rarely worth the cost.
segments.tr: कीट और खरपतवार प्रबंधन का लक्ष्य शून्य कीड़े और शून्य खरपतवार नहीं है—यह आमतौर पर असंभव है और शायद ही कभी लागत के लायक हो।

segments.src: The goal is to keep them below the "economic threshold," the point where the damage they cause is finally worth spending money to stop.
segments.tr: लक्ष्य उन्हें "आर्थिक सीमा" से नीचे रखना है, वह बिंदु जहां वह नुकसान जो वे करते हैं, अंततः इसे रोकने के लिए पैसा खर्च करने के लायक है।

segments.src: Three ideas do most of the work:
segments.tr: तीन विचार अधिकांश काम करते हैं:

segments.src: **Pest ecology.** A pest is just an organism whose population happens to boom where we don't want it.
segments.tr: **कीट पारिस्थितिकी।** एक कीट केवल एक जीव है जिसकी आबादी उस जगह बढ़ती है जहां हम नहीं चाहते।

segments.src: Understanding its life cycle—when it lays eggs, what weather it likes, what it eats—tells you the cheapest moment to intervene.
segments.tr: इसके जीवन चक्र को समझना—यह कब अंडे देता है, इसे कौन सा मौसम पसंद है, यह क्या खाता है—आपको हस्तक्षेप करने का सबसे सस्ता क्षण बताता है।

segments.src: Hit a corn borer as a young larva and a little effort goes a long way; wait until it's tunneled deep into the stalk and you've lost your window.
segments.tr: एक युवा लार्वा के रूप में मकई के बोरर को मारें और थोड़ी मेहनत बहुत काम करती है; तब तक प्रतीक्षा करें जब तक यह तने में गहराई तक सुरंग न बना ले और आप अपनी खिड़की खो देंगे।

segments.src: **Natural enemies (biological control).** Most pests already have predators and parasites.
segments.tr: **प्राकृतिक दुश्मन (जैविक नियंत्रण)।** अधिकांश कीटों के पहले से ही शिकारी और परजीवी होते हैं।

segments.src: Ladybugs and lacewings eat aphids by the hundreds.
segments.tr: लेडीबग्स और लेसविंग्स सैकड़ों में एफिड्स खाते हैं।

segments.src: Tiny parasitic wasps lay eggs inside caterpillars.
segments.tr: छोटी परजीवी ततैयां इलियों के अंदर अंडे देती हैं।

segments.src: Encouraging these "natural enemies"—by planting flower strips, avoiding sprays that kill them, or even releasing them on purpose—turns the ecosystem into free labor.
segments.tr: इन "प्राकृतिक दुश्मनों" को प्रोत्साहित करना—फूलों की पट्टियां लगाकर, उन्हें मारने वाले स्प्रे से बचकर, या जानबूझकर उन्हें छोड़ने से—पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र को मुफ्त श्रम में बदल देता है।

segments.src: **Weed control.** Weeds don't bite, but they steal.
segments.tr: **खरपतवार नियंत्रण।** खरपतवार काटते नहीं हैं, लेकिन वे चोरी करते हैं।

segments.src: They compete for the same resources and can slash yields quietly.
segments.tr: वे समान संसाधनों के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं और शांति से पैदावार को कम कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Control combines mechanical methods (tilling, mowing, mulching), cultural methods (crop rotation, cover crops that shade weeds out), and herbicides used carefully.
segments.tr: नियंत्रण यांत्रिक तरीकों (गहरी जुताई, घास काटना, मल्चिंग), सांस्कृतिक तरीकों (फसल चक्र, कवर फसलें जो खरपतवारों को छाया में रखती हैं), और सावधानी से उपयोग किए जाने वाले शाकनाशकों को जोड़ता है।

segments.src: The modern umbrella term for combining all of this is **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)**: scout the field, identify the actual threat, use the least disruptive tool first, and reach for chemicals only when the numbers justify it.
segments.tr: इस सभी को संयोजित करने के लिए आधुनिक छतरी शब्द **एकीकृत कीट प्रबंधन (IPM)** है: खेत का सर्वेक्षण करें, वास्तविक खतरे की पहचान करें, पहले सबसे कम विघ्नकारी उपकरण का उपयोग करें, और केवल तभी रसायनों के लिए पहुंचें जब संख्याएं इसे न्यायसंगत ठहराएं।

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## दैनंदिन जीवन में

segments.src: Picture a family growing tomatoes in a backyard garden in central Ohio.
segments.tr: एक परिवार को चित्रित करें जो मध्य ओहियो में एक बैकयार्ड बगीचे में टमाटर उगा रहा है।

segments.src: In June, aphids show up on the new leaves.
segments.tr: जून में, एफिड्स नई पत्तियों पर दिखाई देते हैं।

segments.src: The instinct is to grab a bottle of broad-spectrum insecticide from the hardware store for $12 and soak everything.
segments.tr: वृत्ति हार्डवेयर स्टोर से $12 के लिए व्यापक-स्पेक्ट्रम कीटनाशक की बोतल पकड़ना और सब कुछ को भिगोना है।

segments.src: An IPM-minded gardener pauses.
segments.tr: एक IPM-सचेत माली रुकता है।

segments.src: They flip a leaf over and notice ladybug larvae—little spiky orange-and-black creatures—already eating the aphids.
segments.tr: वे एक पत्ती को पलटते हैं और लेडीबग लार्वा—छोटे स्पाइकी नारंगी-और-काली प्राणी—पहले से ही एफिड्स खाते हुए देखते हैं।

segments.src: Spraying now would kill those helpers too, and the aphids would just bounce back next week with nobody left to eat them.
segments.tr: अभी स्प्रे करने से उन सहायकों को भी मार देंगे, और एफिड्स अगले हफ्ते वापस आ जाएंगे जब उन्हें खाने के लिए कोई नहीं होगा।

segments.src: Instead, the gardener sprays a strong jet of water to knock down the worst clusters and plants a few marigolds and sweet alyssum nearby to attract more beneficial insects.
segments.tr: इसके बजाय, माली सबसे बुरे समूहों को मारने के लिए पानी की एक मजबूत जेट स्प्रे करता है और अधिक फायदेमंद कीटों को आकर्षित करने के लिए पास में कुछ गेंदा और मीठी एलिसम रोपता है।

segments.src: Meanwhile, crabgrass is creeping into the bed.
segments.tr: इस बीच, crabgrass बिस्तर में घुसपैठ कर रहा है।

segments.src: Rather than dumping herbicide next to food they'll eat, they lay down a couple inches of straw mulch.
segments.tr: उस भोजन के बगल में शाकनाशक डंप करने के बजाय जो वे खाएंगे, वे भूसे की मल्च की एक जोड़ी इंच बिछाते हैं।

segments.src: The mulch blocks sunlight so new weed seeds can't sprout, holds moisture, and costs about $6 a bale.
segments.tr: मल्च धूप को अवरुद्ध करता है ताकि नए खरपतवार के बीज अंकुरित न हो सकें, नमी को रखता है, और लगभग $6 प्रति गांठ की लागत है।

segments.src: By July, the aphids are under control by the ladybugs, the crabgrass is smothered, and the tomatoes never touched a pesticide.
segments.tr: जुलाई तक, एफिड्स लेडीबग्स द्वारा नियंत्रण में हैं, crabgrass दबा दिया गया है, और टमाटर को कभी कीटनाशक नहीं लगा।

segments.src: That's the same logic a commercial farm in the Central Valley uses—just scaled up with field scouts and thresholds instead of a hunch.
segments.tr: यह सेंट्रल वैली के एक व्यावसायिक खेत द्वारा उपयोग किया जाने वाला एक ही तर्क है—बस अनुमान के बजाय खेत के स्काउट्स और सीमा के साथ स्केल किया गया।

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## तीन-लाइन सारांश

segments.src: 1. The aim is to keep pests and weeds below an economic threshold, not to eliminate them entirely.
segments.tr: 1. लक्ष्य कीटों और खरपतवारों को आर्थिक सीमा से नीचे रखना है, उन्हें पूरी तरह खत्म करना नहीं।

segments.src: 2. Natural enemies like ladybugs and parasitic wasps provide free, self-renewing pest control—so avoid killing them with careless spraying.
segments.tr: 2. लेडीबग्स और परजीवी ततैयों जैसे प्राकृतिक दुश्मन मुफ्त, आत्म-नवीकरण कीट नियंत्रण प्रदान करते हैं—इसलिए लापरवाही से स्प्रे करने से उन्हें मार न डालें।

segments.src: 3. Integrated Pest Management (IPM) layers scouting, biological, mechanical, and cultural methods, using chemicals only as a last resort.
segments.tr: 3. एकीकृत कीट प्रबंधन (IPM) सर्वेक्षण, जैविक, यांत्रिक, और सांस्कृतिक तरीकों को परतों में डालता है, केवल अंतिम उपाय के रूप में रसायनों का उपयोग करता है।

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 आज की शर्तें

segments.src: - **Economic threshold** — The pest density at which the cost of control equals the crop loss it prevents; the tipping point for taking action.
segments.tr: - **आर्थिक सीमा** — कीट घनत्व जिस पर नियंत्रण की लागत उस फसल के नुकसान के बराबर है जो यह रोकता है; कार्रवाई करने का टर्निंग पॉइंट।

segments.src: - **Natural enemy** — A predator, parasite, or pathogen that suppresses a pest population naturally.
segments.tr: - **प्राकृतिक दुश्मन** — एक शिकारी, परजीवी, या रोगज़नक़ जो कीट जनसंख्या को स्वाभाविक रूप से दबाता है।

segments.src: - **Biological control** — Using living organisms (like ladybugs or parasitic wasps) to keep pests in check.
segments.tr: - **जैविक नियंत्रण** — कीटों को नियंत्रण में रखने के लिए जीवित जीवों (जैसे लेडीबग्स या परजीवी ततैयों) का उपयोग करना।

segments.src: - **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)** — A strategy that combines monitoring with biological, cultural, mechanical, and chemical tools, minimizing reliance on any single method.
segments.tr: - **एकीकृत कीट प्रबंधन (IPM)** — एक रणनीति जो निगरानी को जैविक, सांस्कृतिक, यांत्रिक और रासायनिक उपकरणों के साथ जोड़ती है, किसी भी एक विधि पर निर्भरता को कम करती है।

segments.src: - **Cover crop** — A plant grown mainly to protect and improve soil, which can also shade out and suppress weeds.

es.title: [Agriculture 101 #12] Plagas, Malezas, y los Pequeños Aliados que Luchan de Vuelta

segments.src: > Managing pests and weeds isn't about wiping them out—it's about keeping them below the level where they cost you more than the crop is worth.
segments.tr: > Gestionar plagas y malezas no se trata de eliminarlas por completo—se trata de mantenerlas por debajo del nivel donde te cuesten más de lo que vale la cosecha.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concepto de Hoy

segments.src: Every field is a crowded neighborhood.
segments.tr: Cada campo es un vecindario abarrotado.

segments.src: Your crop lives there, but so do insects that chew on it, and weeds that race it for sunlight, water, and nutrients.
segments.tr: Tu cosecha vive allí, pero también insectos que la mastican y malezas que compiten con ella por luz solar, agua y nutrientes.

segments.src: The goal of pest and weed management is not zero bugs and zero weeds—that's usually impossible and rarely worth the cost.
segments.tr: El objetivo de la gestión de plagas y malezas no es cero insectos y cero malezas—eso es usualmente imposible y rara vez vale la pena el costo.

segments.src: The goal is to keep them below the "economic threshold," the point where the damage they cause is finally worth spending money to stop.
segments.tr: El objetivo es mantenerlas por debajo del "umbral económico", el punto donde el daño que causan finalmente vale la pena gastar dinero para detener.

segments.src: Three ideas do most of the work:
segments.tr: Tres ideas hacen la mayor parte del trabajo:

segments.src: **Pest ecology.** A pest is just an organism whose population happens to boom where we don't want it.
segments.tr: **Ecología de plagas.** Una plaga es simplemente un organismo cuya población tiende a crecer donde no la queremos.

segments.src: Understanding its life cycle—when it lays eggs, what weather it likes, what it eats—tells you the cheapest moment to intervene.
segments.tr: Entender su ciclo de vida—cuándo pone huevos, qué clima le gusta, qué come—te dice el momento más económico para intervenir.

segments.src: Hit a corn borer as a young larva and a little effort goes a long way; wait until it's tunneled deep into the stalk and you've lost your window.
segments.tr: Golpea un barrenador del maíz cuando es una larva joven y poco esfuerzo rinde mucho; espera hasta que haya hecho túneles profundos en el tallo y habrás perdido tu oportunidad.

segments.src: **Natural enemies (biological control).** Most pests already have predators and parasites.
segments.tr: **Enemigos naturales (control biológico).** La mayoría de las plagas ya tienen depredadores y parásitos.

segments.src: Ladybugs and lacewings eat aphids by the hundreds.
segments.tr: Las mariquitas y los crisopas comen áfidos por cientos.

segments.src: Tiny parasitic wasps lay eggs inside caterpillars.
segments.tr: Pequeñas avispas parasitoides ponen huevos dentro de las orugas.

segments.src: Encouraging these "natural enemies"—by planting flower strips, avoiding sprays that kill them, or even releasing them on purpose—turns the ecosystem into free labor.
segments.tr: Alentar estos "enemigos naturales"—plantando franjas de flores, evitando sprays que los maten, o incluso liberándolos a propósito—convierte el ecosistema en mano de obra gratuita.

segments.src: **Weed control.** Weeds don't bite, but they steal.
segments.tr: **Control de malezas.** Las malezas no muerden, pero roban.

segments.src: They compete for the same resources and can slash yields quietly.
segments.tr: Compiten por los mismos recursos y pueden reducir los rendimientos silenciosamente.

segments.src: Control combines mechanical methods (tilling, mowing, mulching), cultural methods (crop rotation, cover crops that shade weeds out), and herbicides used carefully.
segments.tr: El control combina métodos mecánicos (arado, siega, acolchado), métodos culturales (rotación de cultivos, cultivos de cobertura que sombrean las malezas), e herbicidas usados cuidadosamente.

segments.src: The modern umbrella term for combining all of this is **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)**: scout the field, identify the actual threat, use the least disruptive tool first, and reach for chemicals only when the numbers justify it.
segments.tr: El término paraguas moderno para combinar todo esto es **Manejo Integrado de Plagas (MIP)**: examina el campo, identifica la amenaza real, usa primero la herramienta menos disruptiva, y recurre a químicos solo cuando los números lo justifiquen.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## En la Vida Cotidiana

segments.src: Picture a family growing tomatoes in a backyard garden in central Ohio.
segments.tr: Imagina una familia cultivando tomates en un jardín trasero en el centro de Ohio.

segments.src: In June, aphids show up on the new leaves.
segments.tr: En junio, los áfidos aparecen en las nuevas hojas.

segments.src: The instinct is to grab a bottle of broad-spectrum insecticide from the hardware store for $12 and soak everything.
segments.tr: El instinto es agarrar una botella de insecticida de amplio espectro de la ferretería por $12 y empapar todo.

segments.src: An IPM-minded gardener pauses.
segments.tr: Un jardinero con mentalidad MIP se detiene.

segments.src: They flip a leaf over and notice ladybug larvae—little spiky orange-and-black creatures—already eating the aphids.
segments.tr: Voltea una hoja y nota larvas de mariquita—pequeñas criaturas puntiagudas naranja y negras—ya comiendo los áfidos.

segments.src: Spraying now would kill those helpers too, and the aphids would just bounce back next week with nobody left to eat them.
segments.tr: Rociar ahora también mataría a esos ayudantes, y los áfidos simplemente rebotarían la próxima semana sin nadie que los coma.

segments.src: Instead, the gardener sprays a strong jet of water to knock down the worst clusters and plants a few marigolds and sweet alyssum nearby to attract more beneficial insects.
segments.tr: En su lugar, el jardinero rocía un chorro fuerte de agua para derribar los peores racimos y planta algunos cempasúchiles y alíssum dulce cerca para atraer más insectos benéficos.

segments.src: Meanwhile, crabgrass is creeping into the bed.
segments.tr: Mientras tanto, la pata de gallo se desliza hacia la cama.

segments.src: Rather than dumping herbicide next to food they'll eat, they lay down a couple inches of straw mulch.
segments.tr: En lugar de verter herbicida junto a la comida que comerán, colocan un par de pulgadas de mulch de paja.

segments.src: The mulch blocks sunlight so new weed seeds can't sprout, holds moisture, and costs about $6 a bale.
segments.tr: El mulch bloquea la luz solar para que las nuevas semillas de malezas no puedan brotar, retiene la humedad y cuesta alrededor de $6 por fardo.

segments.src: By July, the aphids are under control by the ladybugs, the crabgrass is smothered, and the tomatoes never touched a pesticide.
segments.tr: Para julio, los áfidos están bajo control por las mariquitas, la pata de gallo está sofocada, y los tomates nunca tocaron un pesticida.

segments.src: That's the same logic a commercial farm in the Central Valley uses—just scaled up with field scouts and thresholds instead of a hunch.
segments.tr: Esa es la misma lógica que usa una granja comercial en el Valle Central—solo ampliada con exploradores de campo y umbrales en lugar de una corazonada.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Resumen de Tres Líneas

segments.src: 1. The aim is to keep pests and weeds below an economic threshold, not to eliminate them entirely.
segments.tr: 1. El objetivo es mantener las plagas y malezas por debajo de un umbral económico, no eliminarlas completamente.

segments.src: 2. Natural enemies like ladybugs and parasitic wasps provide free, self-renewing pest control—so avoid killing them with careless spraying.
segments.tr: 2. Los enemigos naturales como las mariquitas y las avispas parasitoides proporcionan control de plagas gratuito y autorrenovable—así que evita matarlos con rociado descuidado.

segments.src: 3. Integrated Pest Management (IPM) layers scouting, biological, mechanical, and cultural methods, using chemicals only as a last resort.
segments.tr: 3. El Manejo Integrado de Plagas (MIP) combina en capas exploración, métodos biológicos, mecánicos y culturales, usando químicos solo como último recurso.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Términos de Hoy

segments.src: - **Economic threshold** — The pest density at which the cost of control equals the crop loss it prevents; the tipping point for taking action.
segments.tr: - **Umbral económico** — La densidad de plagas en la que el costo del control iguala la pérdida de cosecha que previene; el punto de inflexión para tomar medidas.

segments.src: - **Natural enemy** — A predator, parasite, or pathogen that suppresses a pest population naturally.
segments.tr: - **Enemigo natural** — Un depredador, parásito o patógeno que suprime una población de plagas naturalmente.

segments.src: - **Biological control** — Using living organisms (like ladybugs or parasitic wasps) to keep pests in check.
segments.tr: - **Control biológico** — Usar organismos vivos (como mariquitas o avispas parasitoides) para mantener las plagas bajo control.

segments.src: - **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)** — A strategy that combines monitoring with biological, cultural, mechanical, and chemical tools, minimizing reliance on any single method.
segments.tr: - **Manejo Integrado de Plagas (MIP)** — Una estrategia que combina monitoreo con herramientas biológicas, culturales, mecánicas y químicas, minimizando la dependencia de cualquier método único.

segments.src: - **Cover crop** — A plant grown mainly to protect and improve soil, which can also shade out and suppress weeds.
segments.tr: - **Cultivo de cobertura** — Una planta cultivada principalmente para proteger y mejorar el suelo, que también puede sombrear y suprimir malezas.

segments.src: *Answers: 1) B — the threshold is about economics, spending on control only when damage would cost more.
segments.tr: *Respuestas: 1) B — el umbral se trata de economía, gastar en control solo cuando el daño costaría más.

segments.src: 2) X — broad-spectrum sprays often kill the beneficial insects too, so pests rebound; scout first and use the least disruptive tool.
segments.tr: 2) F — los sprays de amplio espectro a menudo matan también a los insectos benéficos, así que las plagas rebotan; explora primero y usa la herramienta menos disruptiva.

segments.src: 3) C — releasing parasitic wasps uses a living organism, making it biological control; tilling is mechanical and herbicide is chemical.*
segments.tr: 3) C — liberar avispas parasitoides usa un organismo vivo, haciéndolo control biológico; arar es mecánico y el herbicida es químico.*

fr.title: [Agriculture 101 #12] Insectes, mauvaises herbes et les minuscules alliés qui ripostent

segments.src: > Managing pests and weeds isn't about wiping them out—it's about keeping them below the level where they cost you more than the crop is worth.
segments.tr: > Gérer les ravageurs et les mauvaises herbes ne s'agit pas de les éradiquer—il s'agit de les maintenir en dessous du niveau où ils vous coûtent plus que la récolte ne vaut.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Le concept d'aujourd'hui

segments.src: Every field is a crowded neighborhood.
segments.tr: Chaque champ est un quartier surpeuplé.

segments.src: Your crop lives there, but so do insects that chew on it, and weeds that race it for sunlight, water, and nutrients.
segments.tr: Votre récolte y vit, mais aussi des insectes qui la rongent et des mauvaises herbes qui rivalisent avec elle pour la lumière, l'eau et les nutriments.

segments.src: The goal of pest and weed management is not zero bugs and zero weeds—that's usually impossible and rarely worth the cost.
segments.tr: L'objectif de la gestion des ravageurs et des mauvaises herbes n'est pas zéro insecte et zéro mauvaise herbe—c'est généralement impossible et rarement rentable.

segments.src: The goal is to keep them below the "economic threshold," the point where the damage they cause is finally worth spending money to stop.
segments.tr: L'objectif est de les maintenir en dessous du « seuil économique », le point où les dommages qu'ils causent valent enfin la peine de dépenser de l'argent pour les arrêter.

segments.src: Three ideas do most of the work:
segments.tr: Trois idées font la plupart du travail :

segments.src: **Pest ecology.** A pest is just an organism whose population happens to boom where we don't want it.
segments.tr: **Écologie des ravageurs.** Un ravageur est simplement un organisme dont la population explose là où nous ne le souhaitons pas.

segments.src: Understanding its life cycle—when it lays eggs, what weather it likes, what it eats—tells you the cheapest moment to intervene.
segments.tr: Comprendre son cycle de vie—quand il pond des œufs, le temps qu'il préfère, ce qu'il mange—vous dit le moment le moins cher pour intervenir.

segments.src: Hit a corn borer as a young larva and a little effort goes a long way; wait until it's tunneled deep into the stalk and you've lost your window.
segments.tr: Frappez un foreur du maïs à l'état de jeune larve et un petit effort porte loin ; attendez qu'il ait creusé profondément dans la tige et vous aurez perdu votre fenêtre.

segments.src: **Natural enemies (biological control).** Most pests already have predators and parasites.
segments.tr: **Ennemis naturels (lutte biologique).** La plupart des ravageurs ont déjà des prédateurs et des parasites.

segments.src: Ladybugs and lacewings eat aphids by the hundreds.
segments.tr: Les coccinelles et les chrysopes mangent les pucerons par centaines.

segments.src: Tiny parasitic wasps lay eggs inside caterpillars.
segments.tr: Les minuscules guêpes parasites pondent leurs œufs à l'intérieur des chenilles.

segments.src: Encouraging these "natural enemies"—by planting flower strips, avoiding sprays that kill them, or even releasing them on purpose—turns the ecosystem into free labor.
segments.tr: Encourager ces « ennemis naturels »—en plantant des bandes de fleurs, en évitant les pulvérisations qui les tuent, ou même en les libérant intentionnellement—transforme l'écosystème en travail gratuit.

segments.src: **Weed control.** Weeds don't bite, but they steal.
segments.tr: **Lutte contre les mauvaises herbes.** Les mauvaises herbes ne mordent pas, mais elles volent.

segments.src: They compete for the same resources and can slash yields quietly.
segments.tr: Elles rivalisent pour les mêmes ressources et peuvent réduire les rendements silencieusement.

segments.src: Control combines mechanical methods (tilling, mowing, mulching), cultural methods (crop rotation, cover crops that shade weeds out), and herbicides used carefully.
segments.tr: Le contrôle combine des méthodes mécaniques (labourage, tonte, paillage), des méthodes culturales (rotation des cultures, cultures de couverture qui ombragent les mauvaises herbes) et des herbicides utilisés avec prudence.

segments.src: The modern umbrella term for combining all of this is **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)**: scout the field, identify the actual threat, use the least disruptive tool first, and reach for chemicals only when the numbers justify it.
segments.tr: Le terme générique moderne pour combiner tout cela est la **Gestion intégrée des ravageurs (GIR)** : explorez le champ, identifiez la menace réelle, utilisez d'abord l'outil le moins perturbateur, et recourez aux produits chimiques uniquement quand les chiffres le justifient.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: Picture a family growing tomatoes in a backyard garden in central Ohio.
segments.tr: Imaginez une famille cultivant des tomates dans un jardin de cour arrière en Ohio central.

segments.src: In June, aphids show up on the new leaves.
segments.tr: En juin, des pucerons apparaissent sur les nouvelles feuilles.

segments.src: The instinct is to grab a bottle of broad-spectrum insecticide from the hardware store for $12 and soak everything.
segments.tr: L'instinct est d'attraper une bouteille d'insecticide à large spectre à la quincaillerie pour 12 $ et de tout tremper.

segments.src: An IPM-minded gardener pauses.
segments.tr: Un jardinier ayant l'esprit GIR s'arrête.

segments.src: They flip a leaf over and notice ladybug larvae—little spiky orange-and-black creatures—already eating the aphids.
segments.tr: Il retourne une feuille et remarque des larves de coccinelle—petites créatures orange et noir pointues—en train de manger les pucerons.

segments.src: Spraying now would kill those helpers too, and the aphids would just bounce back next week with nobody left to eat them.
segments.tr: Pulvériser maintenant tuerait aussi ces aides, et les pucerons rebondiraient juste la semaine prochaine sans personne pour les manger.

segments.src: Instead, the gardener sprays a strong jet of water to knock down the worst clusters and plants a few marigolds and sweet alyssum nearby to attract more beneficial insects.
segments.tr: Au lieu de cela, le jardinier pulvérise un puissant jet d'eau pour éliminer les pires grappes et plante quelques soucis et alysse odorante à proximité pour attirer plus d'insectes bénéfiques.

segments.src: Meanwhile, crabgrass is creeping into the bed.
segments.tr: Pendant ce temps, le chiendent s'infiltre dans le lit.

segments.src: Rather than dumping herbicide next to food they'll eat, they lay down a couple inches of straw mulch.
segments.tr: Plutôt que de verser un herbicide près de la nourriture qu'il mangera, il étend quelques centimètres de paillis de paille.

segments.src: The mulch blocks sunlight so new weed seeds can't sprout, holds moisture, and costs about $6 a bale.
segments.tr: Le paillis bloque la lumière du soleil afin que les nouvelles graines de mauvaises herbes ne puissent pas germer, retient l'humidité et coûte environ 6 $ par balle.

segments.src: By July, the aphids are under control by the ladybugs, the crabgrass is smothered, and the tomatoes never touched a pesticide.
segments.tr: En juillet, les pucerons sont sous contrôle par les coccinelles, le chiendent est étouffé, et les tomates n'ont jamais touché un pesticide.

segments.src: That's the same logic a commercial farm in the Central Valley uses—just scaled up with field scouts and thresholds instead of a hunch.
segments.tr: C'est la même logique qu'une ferme commerciale dans la Vallée centrale utilise—juste mise à l'échelle avec des explorateurs de champ et des seuils au lieu d'une intuition.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Résumé en trois lignes

segments.src: 1. The aim is to keep pests and weeds below an economic threshold, not to eliminate them entirely.
segments.tr: 1. L'objectif est de maintenir les ravageurs et les mauvaises herbes en dessous d'un seuil économique, non pas de les éliminer entièrement.

segments.src: 2. Natural enemies like ladybugs and parasitic wasps provide free, self-renewing pest control—so avoid killing them with careless spraying.
segments.tr: 2. Les ennemis naturels comme les coccinelles et les guêpes parasites fournissent un contrôle des ravageurs gratuit et auto-renouvelable—donc évitez de les tuer avec une pulvérisation négligente.

segments.src: 3. Integrated Pest Management (IPM) layers scouting, biological, mechanical, and cultural methods, using chemicals only as a last resort.
segments.tr: 3. La Gestion intégrée des ravageurs (GIR) superpose l'exploration, les méthodes biologiques, mécaniques et culturales, en utilisant des produits chimiques en dernier recours.

in.title: [Agriculture 101 #12] Hama, Gulma, dan Sekutu Kecil yang Melawan Balik

segments.src: > Managing pests and weeds isn't about wiping them out—it's about keeping them below the level where they cost you more than the crop is worth.
segments.tr: > Mengelola hama dan gulma bukan tentang menghilangkan mereka—tetapi tentang menjaga mereka di bawah tingkat di mana mereka menghabiskan biaya lebih banyak daripada nilai panen.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Every field is a crowded neighborhood.
segments.tr: Setiap lahan adalah lingkungan yang ramai.

segments.src: Your crop lives there, but so do insects that chew on it, and weeds that race it for sunlight, water, and nutrients.
segments.tr: Tanaman Anda hidup di sana, tetapi begitu juga serangga yang mengunyahnya, dan gulma yang berkompetisi dengannya untuk sinar matahari, air, dan nutrisi.

segments.src: The goal of pest and weed management is not zero bugs and zero weeds—that's usually impossible and rarely worth the cost.
segments.tr: Tujuan pengelolaan hama dan gulma bukan nol serangga dan nol gulma—itu biasanya tidak mungkin dan jarang sepadan dengan biayanya.

segments.src: The goal is to keep them below the "economic threshold," the point where the damage they cause is finally worth spending money to stop.
segments.tr: Tujuannya adalah menjaga mereka di bawah "ambang batas ekonomi," titik di mana kerusakan yang mereka timbulkan akhirnya layak dihabiskan uang untuk dihentikan.

segments.src: Three ideas do most of the work:
segments.tr: Tiga ide melakukan sebagian besar pekerjaan:

segments.src: **Pest ecology.** A pest is just an organism whose population happens to boom where we don't want it.
segments.tr: **Ekologi hama.** Hama hanyalah organisme yang populasinya tiba-tiba meledak di tempat yang tidak kami inginkan.

segments.src: Understanding its life cycle—when it lays eggs, what weather it likes, what it eats—tells you the cheapest moment to intervene.
segments.tr: Memahami siklus hidupnya—kapan ia bertelur, cuaca apa yang disukai, apa yang dimakannya—memberi tahu Anda momen termurah untuk campur tangan.

segments.src: Hit a corn borer as a young larva and a little effort goes a long way; wait until it's tunneled deep into the stalk and you've lost your window.
segments.tr: Bergerak cepat pada penggerek jagung saat masih larva muda dan sedikit usaha sudah cukup; tunggu sampai ia menggali dalam batang dan Anda telah kehilangan kesempatan Anda.

segments.src: **Natural enemies (biological control).** Most pests already have predators and parasites.
segments.tr: **Musuh alami (pengendalian biologis).** Sebagian besar hama sudah memiliki pemangsa dan parasit.

segments.src: Ladybugs and lacewings eat aphids by the hundreds.
segments.tr: Kepik dan lacewings memakan aphid dalam jumlah ratusan.

segments.src: Tiny parasitic wasps lay eggs inside caterpillars.
segments.tr: Tawon parasit kecil bertelur di dalam ulat.

segments.src: Encouraging these "natural enemies"—by planting flower strips, avoiding sprays that kill them, or even releasing them on purpose—turns the ecosystem into free labor.
segments.tr: Mendorong "musuh alami" ini—dengan menanam strip bunga, menghindari semprotan yang membunuh mereka, atau bahkan melepaskan mereka dengan sengaja—mengubah ekosistem menjadi tenaga kerja gratis.

segments.src: **Weed control.** Weeds don't bite, but they steal.
segments.tr: **Pengendalian gulma.** Gulma tidak menggigit, tetapi mereka mencuri.

segments.src: They compete for the same resources and can slash yields quietly.
segments.tr: Mereka bersaing untuk sumber daya yang sama dan dapat mengurangi hasil panen secara diam-diam.

segments.src: Control combines mechanical methods (tilling, mowing, mulching), cultural methods (crop rotation, cover crops that shade weeds out), and herbicides used carefully.
segments.tr: Pengendalian menggabungkan metode mekanis (pengolahan tanah, pemotongan, mulsa), metode budaya (rotasi tanaman, tanaman penutup yang mengarsir gulma), dan herbisida yang digunakan dengan hati-hati.

segments.src: The modern umbrella term for combining all of this is **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)**: scout the field, identify the actual threat, use the least disruptive tool first, and reach for chemicals only when the numbers justify it.
segments.tr: Istilah payung modern untuk menggabungkan semua ini adalah **Manajemen Hama Terpadu (IPM)**: jelajahi lahan, identifikasi ancaman sebenarnya, gunakan alat yang paling tidak mengganggu terlebih dahulu, dan capai bahan kimia hanya ketika angka membenarkannya.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Picture a family growing tomatoes in a backyard garden in central Ohio.
segments.tr: Bayangkan sebuah keluarga menanam tomat di taman halaman belakang di Ohio tengah.

segments.src: In June, aphids show up on the new leaves.
segments.tr: Pada bulan Juni, aphid muncul di daun-daun baru.

segments.src: The instinct is to grab a bottle of broad-spectrum insecticide from the hardware store for $12 and soak everything.
segments.tr: Insting adalah mengambil botol insektisida spektrum luas dari toko perangkat keras seharga $12 dan merendam semuanya.

segments.src: An IPM-minded gardener pauses.
segments.tr: Seorang tukang kebun yang berpikiran IPM berhenti.

segments.src: They flip a leaf over and notice ladybug larvae—little spiky orange-and-black creatures—already eating the aphids.
segments.tr: Mereka membalik daun dan memperhatikan larva kepik—makhluk kecil berduri oranye-hitam—sudah memakan aphid.

segments.src: Spraying now would kill those helpers too, and the aphids would just bounce back next week with nobody left to eat them.
segments.tr: Menyemprot sekarang akan membunuh pembantu itu juga, dan aphid akan kembali minggu depan tanpa siapa pun yang tersisa untuk memakannya.

segments.src: Instead, the gardener sprays a strong jet of water to knock down the worst clusters and plants a few marigolds and sweet alyssum nearby to attract more beneficial insects.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, tukang kebun menyemprotkan aliran air yang kuat untuk menghilangkan kelompok terburuk dan menanam beberapa marigold dan sweet alyssum di dekatnya untuk menarik lebih banyak serangga bermanfaat.

segments.src: Meanwhile, crabgrass is creeping into the bed.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, rumput kepiting merambat masuk ke tempat tidur.

segments.src: Rather than dumping herbicide next to food they'll eat, they lay down a couple inches of straw mulch.
segments.tr: Alih-alih menuangkan herbisida di samping makanan yang akan mereka makan, mereka meletakkan beberapa inci mulsa jerami.

segments.src: The mulch blocks sunlight so new weed seeds can't sprout, holds moisture, and costs about $6 a bale.
segments.tr: Mulsa memblokir sinar matahari sehingga benih gulma baru tidak bisa tumbuh, menahan kelembaban, dan biaya sekitar $6 per balok.

segments.src: By July, the aphids are under control by the ladybugs, the crabgrass is smothered, and the tomatoes never touched a pesticide.
segments.tr: Pada bulan Juli, aphid dikendalikan oleh kepik, rumput kepiting tercekik, dan tomat tidak pernah menyentuh pestisida.

segments.src: That's the same logic a commercial farm in the Central Valley uses—just scaled up with field scouts and thresholds instead of a hunch.
segments.tr: Itu adalah logika yang sama yang digunakan pertanian komersial di Central Valley—hanya diperbesar dengan pandu lahan dan ambang batas alih-alih firasat.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Ringkasan Tiga Baris

segments.src: 1. The aim is to keep pests and weeds below an economic threshold, not to eliminate them entirely.
segments.tr: 1. Tujuannya adalah menjaga hama dan gulma di bawah ambang batas ekonomi, bukan untuk menghilangkan mereka sepenuhnya.

segments.src: 2. Natural enemies like ladybugs and parasitic wasps provide free, self-renewing pest control—so avoid killing them with careless spraying.
segments.tr: 2. Musuh alami seperti kepik dan tawon parasit menyediakan pengendalian hama gratis yang memperbarui diri—jadi hindari membunuh mereka dengan penyemprotan ceroboh.

segments.src: 3. Integrated Pest Management (IPM) layers scouting, biological, mechanical, and cultural methods, using chemicals only as a last resort.
segments.tr: 3. Manajemen Hama Terpadu (IPM) menggabungkan penjelajahan, metode biologis, mekanis, dan budaya, menggunakan bahan kimia hanya sebagai upaya terakhir.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Every field is a crowded neighborhood.

segments.src: Your crop lives there, but so do insects that chew on it, and weeds that race it for sunlight, water, and nutrients.

segments.src: The goal of pest and weed management is not zero bugs and zero weeds—that's usually impossible and rarely worth the cost.

segments.src: The goal is to keep them below the "economic threshold," the point where the damage they cause is finally worth spending money to stop.

segments.src: Three ideas do most of the work:
segments.tr: 3つのアイデアがほとんどの仕事をします：

segments.src: **Pest ecology.** A pest is just an organism whose population happens to boom where we don't want it.

segments.src: Understanding its life cycle—when it lays eggs, what weather it likes, what it eats—tells you the cheapest moment to intervene.

segments.src: Hit a corn borer as a young larva and a little effort goes a long way; wait until it's tunneled deep into the stalk and you've lost your window.

segments.src: **Natural enemies (biological control).** Most pests already have predators and parasites.
segments.tr: **天敵（生物的防除）。** ほとんどの害虫は既に捕食者と寄生虫を持っています。

segments.src: Encouraging these "natural enemies"—by planting flower strips, avoiding sprays that kill them, or even releasing them on purpose—turns the ecosystem into free labor.
segments.tr: これらの「天敵」を奨励する（花の帯を植える、それらを殺すスプレーを避ける、または意図的にそれらを放つなど）ことは、エコシステムを無料労働に変えます。

segments.src: **Weed control.** Weeds don't bite, but they steal.

segments.src: They compete for the same resources and can slash yields quietly.

segments.src: Control combines mechanical methods (tilling, mowing, mulching), cultural methods (crop rotation, cover crops that shade weeds out), and herbicides used carefully.

segments.src: The modern umbrella term for combining all of this is **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)**: scout the field, identify the actual threat, use the least disruptive tool first, and reach for chemicals only when the numbers justify it.
segments.tr: これすべてを組み合わせるための現代的な包括的用語は**統合害虫管理（IPM）**です：畑をスカウトし、実際の脅威を特定し、最初に最も破壊的でない道具を使用し、数字がそれを正当化する場合にのみ化学物質に手を伸ばします。

de.title: [Landwirtschaft 101 #12] Schädlinge, Unkräuter und die winzigen Verbündeten, die zurückkämpfen

segments.src: > Managing pests and weeds isn't about wiping them out—it's about keeping them below the level where they cost you more than the crop is worth.
segments.tr: > Schädlings- und Unkrautbekämpfung ist nicht darauf ausgerichtet, sie auszurotten – es geht darum, sie unter dem Niveau zu halten, wo sie dich mehr kosten als die Ernte wert ist.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konzept von Heute

segments.src: Every field is a crowded neighborhood.
segments.tr: Jedes Feld ist eine überbevölkerte Nachbarschaft.

segments.src: Your crop lives there, but so do insects that chew on it, and weeds that race it for sunlight, water, and nutrients.
segments.tr: Deine Ernte lebt dort, aber auch Insekten, die daran kauen, und Unkräuter, die mit ihr um Sonnenlicht, Wasser und Nährstoffe konkurrieren.

segments.src: The goal of pest and weed management is not zero bugs and zero weeds—that's usually impossible and rarely worth the cost.
segments.tr: Das Ziel der Schädlings- und Unkrautbekämpfung ist nicht null Insekten und null Unkräuter – das ist normalerweise unmöglich und selten die Kosten wert.

segments.src: The goal is to keep them below the "economic threshold," the point where the damage they cause is finally worth spending money to stop.
segments.tr: Das Ziel ist, sie unter der "wirtschaftlichen Schwelle" zu halten, dem Punkt, an dem der Schaden, den sie verursachen, endlich Geld wert ist, um ihn zu stoppen.

segments.src: Three ideas do most of the work:
segments.tr: Drei Ideen leisten die meiste Arbeit:

segments.src: **Pest ecology.** A pest is just an organism whose population happens to boom where we don't want it.
segments.tr: **Schädlingsökologie.** Ein Schädling ist einfach ein Organismus, dessen Population dort boomen kann, wo wir es nicht wollen.

segments.src: Understanding its life cycle—when it lays eggs, what weather it likes, what it eats—tells you the cheapest moment to intervene.
segments.tr: Das Verständnis seines Lebenszyklus – wann es Eier legt, welches Wetter es mag, was es frisst – sagt dir den günstigsten Moment zum Eingreifen.

segments.src: Hit a corn borer as a young larva and a little effort goes a long way; wait until it's tunneled deep into the stalk and you've lost your window.
segments.tr: Treffe einen Maiszünsler als junge Larve und wenig Aufwand wirkt lange; warte bis er sich tief in den Stengel eingegraben hat und du hast dein Fenster verloren.

segments.src: **Natural enemies (biological control).** Most pests already have predators and parasites.
segments.tr: **Natürliche Feinde (biologische Kontrolle).** Die meisten Schädlinge haben bereits Raubtiere und Parasiten.

segments.src: Ladybugs and lacewings eat aphids by the hundreds.
segments.tr: Marienkäfer und Florfliegen essen Blattläuse zu Hunderten.

segments.src: Tiny parasitic wasps lay eggs inside caterpillars.
segments.tr: Winzige parasitäre Wespen legen Eier in Raupen.

segments.src: Encouraging these "natural enemies"—by planting flower strips, avoiding sprays that kill them, or even releasing them on purpose—turns the ecosystem into free labor.
segments.tr: Das Ermutigen dieser "natürlichen Feinde" – durch Pflanzen von Blütenstreifen, das Vermeiden von Sprays, die sie töten, oder sogar das absichtliche Freisetzen – verwandelt das Ökosystem in kostenlose Arbeit.

segments.src: **Weed control.** Weeds don't bite, but they steal.
segments.tr: **Unkrautbekämpfung.** Unkräuter beißen nicht, aber sie stehlen.

segments.src: They compete for the same resources and can slash yields quietly.
segments.tr: Sie konkurrieren um die gleichen Ressourcen und können Erträge leise reduzieren.

segments.src: Control combines mechanical methods (tilling, mowing, mulching), cultural methods (crop rotation, cover crops that shade weeds out), and herbicides used carefully.
segments.tr: Die Bekämpfung kombiniert mechanische Methoden (Umgraben, Mähen, Mulchen), kulturelle Methoden (Fruchtfolge, Deckfrüchte, die Unkräuter beschatten) und vorsichtig eingesetzte Herbizide.

segments.src: The modern umbrella term for combining all of this is **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)**: scout the field, identify the actual threat, use the least disruptive tool first, and reach for chemicals only when the numbers justify it.
segments.tr: Der moderne Oberbegriff für die Kombination all dessen ist **Integrierter Pflanzenschutz (IPM)**: Feld erkunden, die tatsächliche Bedrohung identifizieren, zuerst das am wenigsten störende Werkzeug verwenden und nur dann zu Chemikalien greifen, wenn die Zahlen es rechtfertigen.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Im Alltag

segments.src: Picture a family growing tomatoes in a backyard garden in central Ohio.
segments.tr: Stelle dir eine Familie vor, die Tomaten in einem Hinterhofgarten in Zentralohio anbaut.

segments.src: In June, aphids show up on the new leaves.
segments.tr: Im Juni erscheinen Blattläuse auf den neuen Blättern.

segments.src: The instinct is to grab a bottle of broad-spectrum insecticide from the hardware store for $12 and soak everything.
segments.tr: Der Instinkt ist, eine Flasche Breitspektrum-Insektizid aus dem Baumarkt für $12 zu nehmen und alles durchzutränken.

segments.src: An IPM-minded gardener pauses.
segments.tr: Ein Gärtner mit IPM-Orientierung hält inne.

segments.src: They flip a leaf over and notice ladybug larvae—little spiky orange-and-black creatures—already eating the aphids.
segments.tr: Er klappt ein Blatt um und bemerkt Marienkäferlarven – kleine stachelige orange-schwarze Kreaturen – die bereits Blattläuse essen.

segments.src: Spraying now would kill those helpers too, and the aphids would just bounce back next week with nobody left to eat them.
segments.tr: Das Spritzen würde jetzt auch diese Helfer töten, und die Blattläuse würden nächste Woche einfach zurückkommen, mit niemandem, der sie essen würde.

segments.src: Instead, the gardener sprays a strong jet of water to knock down the worst clusters and plants a few marigolds and sweet alyssum nearby to attract more beneficial insects.
segments.tr: Stattdessen sprüht der Gärtner einen starken Wasserstrahl, um die schlimmsten Cluster zu bekämpfen und pflanzt ein paar Ringelblumen und süßes Steinkraut in der Nähe, um mehr nützliche Insekten anzulocken.

segments.src: Meanwhile, crabgrass is creeping into the bed.
segments.tr: Unterdessen schleicht sich Krabbengras ins Beet.

segments.src: Rather than dumping herbicide next to food they'll eat, they lay down a couple inches of straw mulch.
segments.tr: Anstatt Herbizid neben die Nahrung, die sie essen werden, zu spritzen, legen sie ein paar Zentimeter Strohmulch an.

segments.src: The mulch blocks sunlight so new weed seeds can't sprout, holds moisture, and costs about $6 a bale.
segments.tr: Die Mulchschicht blockiert Sonnenlicht, damit neue Unkrautsamen nicht keimen können, speichert Feuchtigkeit und kostet etwa $6 pro Ballen.

segments.src: By July, the aphids are under control by the ladybugs, the crabgrass is smothered, and the tomatoes never touched a pesticide.
segments.tr: Im Juli werden die Blattläuse durch Marienkäfer kontrolliert, das Krabbengras wird erstickt und die Tomaten berühren niemals ein Pestizid.

segments.src: That's the same logic a commercial farm in the Central Valley uses—just scaled up with field scouts and thresholds instead of a hunch.
segments.tr: Das ist die gleiche Logik, die ein Handelsbetrieb im Central Valley verwendet – nur vergrößert mit Feldaufklärern und Schwellen statt einer Intuition.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Zusammenfassung in drei Zeilen

segments.src: 1. The aim is to keep pests and weeds below an economic threshold, not to eliminate them entirely.
segments.tr: 1. Ziel ist es, Schädlinge und Unkräuter unter einer wirtschaftlichen Schwelle zu halten, nicht sie vollständig zu beseitigen.

segments.src: 2. Natural enemies like ladybugs and parasitic wasps provide free, self-renewing pest control—so avoid killing them with careless spraying.
segments.tr: 2. Natürliche Feinde wie Marienkäfer und parasitäre Wespen bieten kostenlose, sich selbst erneuernde Schädlingsbekämpfung – vermeiden Sie also, sie durch sorgloses Spritzen zu töten.

segments.src: 3. Integrated Pest Management (IPM) layers scouting, biological, mechanical, and cultural methods, using chemicals only as a last resort.
segments.tr: 3. Integrierter Pflanzenschutz (IPM) schichtet Aufklärung, biologische, mechanische und kulturelle Methoden, wobei Chemikalien nur als letzter Ausweg verwendet werden.

segments.tr: - A) Das Umgraben des Bodens zum Begraben von Unkräutern

segments.tr: Đó là logic tương tự mà một trang trại thương mại ở Central Valley sử dụng—chỉ được phóng to với những người scouting cánh đồng và ngưỡng thay vì một cảm giác.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Tóm Tắt Ba Dòng

segments.src: 1. The aim is to keep pests and weeds below an economic threshold, not to eliminate them entirely.
segments.tr: 1. Mục tiêu là giữ sâu bệnh và cỏ dại dưới ngưỡng kinh tế, không phải loại bỏ chúng hoàn toàn.

segments.src: 2. Natural enemies like ladybugs and parasitic wasps provide free, self-renewing pest control—so avoid killing them with careless spraying.
segments.tr: 2. Những kẻ thù tự nhiên như bọ rùa và ong ký sinh cung cấp kiểm soát sâu bệnh miễn phí, tự làm mới—vì vậy tránh giết chúng bằng xịt không cẩn thận.

segments.src: 3. Integrated Pest Management (IPM) layers scouting, biological, mechanical, and cultural methods, using chemicals only as a last resort.
segments.tr: 3. Quản lý Sâu bệnh Tích hợp (IPM) kết hợp scouting, phương pháp sinh học, cơ học và canh tác, sử dụng hóa chất chỉ như phương sách cuối cùng.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Tự Kiểm Tra

segments.src: 1. The "economic threshold" refers to:
segments.tr: 1. "Ngưỡng kinh tế" đề cập đến:

segments.src: - A) The price of a bag of seed
segments.tr: - A) Giá của một túi hạt giống

segments.src: - B) The pest population level at which control costs less than the damage prevented
segments.tr: - B) Mức độ quần thể sâu bệnh mà chi phí kiểm soát ít hơn thiệt hại được ngăn chặn

segments.src: - C) The number of weeds allowed by law
segments.tr: - C) Số lượng cỏ dại được phép theo luật pháp

segments.src: 2. O/X: Spraying a broad-spectrum insecticide at the first sign of aphids is usually the smartest first move.
segments.tr: 2. Đ/S: Xịt thuốc diệt côn trùng phổ rộng ở dấu hiệu đầu tiên của mầm non thường là nước đi thông minh đầu tiên.

segments.src: 3. Which of these is a *biological* control method?
segments.tr: 3. Cái nào trong số này là một phương pháp kiểm soát *sinh học*?

segments.src: - A) Tilling the soil to bury weeds
segments.tr: - A) Xới đất để chôn cỏ dại

segments.src: - B) Applying a herbicide
segments.tr: - B) Áp dụng một loại thuốc diệt cỏ

segments.src: - C) Releasing parasitic wasps to attack caterpillars
segments.tr: - C) Thả những con ong ký sinh để tấn công sâu bướm

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Thuật Ngữ Hôm Nay

segments.src: - **Economic threshold** — The pest density at which the cost of control equals the crop loss it prevents; the tipping point for taking action.
segments.tr: - **Ngưỡng kinh tế** — Mật độ sâu bệnh mà chi phí kiểm soát bằng mất mùa nó ngăn chặn; điểm tipping để hành động.

segments.src: - **Natural enemy** — A predator, parasite, or pathogen that suppresses a pest population naturally.
segments.tr: - **Kẻ thù tự nhiên** — Một kẻ ăn thịt, ký sinh trùng hoặc tác nhân gây bệnh ngăn chặn quần thể sâu bệnh một cách tự nhiên.

segments.src: - **Biological control** — Using living organisms (like ladybugs or parasitic wasps) to keep pests in check.
segments.tr: - **Kiểm soát sinh học** — Sử dụng các sinh vật sống (như bọ rùa hoặc ong ký sinh) để giữ sâu bệnh dưới kiểm soát.

segments.src: - **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)** — A strategy that combines monitoring with biological, cultural, mechanical, and chemical tools, minimizing reliance on any single method.
segments.tr: - **Quản lý Sâu bệnh Tích hợp (IPM)** — Một chiến lược kết hợp giám sát với công cụ sinh học, canh tác, cơ học và hóa học, giảm thiểu sự phụ thuộc vào bất kỳ phương pháp nào.

segments.src: - **Cover crop** — A plant grown mainly to protect and improve soil, which can also shade out and suppress weeds.
segments.tr: - **Cây bao phủ** — Một cây trồng chủ yếu để bảo vệ và cải thiện đất, cũng có thể che bóng và ngăn chặn cỏ dại.

segments.src: *Answers: 1) B — the threshold is about economics, spending on control only when damage would cost more.
segments.tr: *Đáp án: 1) B — ngưỡng là về kinh tế, chi tiêu kiểm soát chỉ khi thiệt hại sẽ chi phí hơn.

segments.src: 2) X — broad-spectrum sprays often kill the beneficial insects too, so pests rebound; scout first and use the least disruptive tool.
segments.tr: 2) S — xịt phổ rộng thường giết những côn trùng có ích quá, vì vậy sâu bệnh quay lại; khám phá trước và sử dụng công cụ ít xáo trộn nhất.

segments.src: 3) C — releasing parasitic wasps uses a living organism, making it biological control; tilling is mechanical and herbicide is chemical.*
segments.tr: 3) C — thả những con ong ký sinh sử dụng một sinh vật sống, làm cho nó kiểm soát sinh học; xới đất là cơ học và thuốc diệt cỏ là hóa học.*
